subject: MedSys post-demo: security follow-up + region availability & export pre-check
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Kovács <anna.kovacs@medsys.eu>
Cc: Pablo Torres <p.torres@medsys.eu>
Date: 2027-05-03T07:12:00-04:00
Subject: MedSys post-demo: security follow-up + region availability & export pre-check

Hi Anna / Pablo,

Thanks for the time today — great to learn more about MedSys' telemetry and anonymized notes use case. Quick recap and the concrete items we promised to follow up on from the call: 

Actions / asks for MedSys:
- Please send your completed security questionnaire (I attached the version you mentioned).
- Confirm whether you prefer EU-only residency (Frankfurt) or if cross-border processing is acceptable with data processing addendum (DPA).

What I’ll do this week:
- Share our most recent (redacted) SOC 2 Type II report.
- Confirm whether Redwood has any export-control flags (OFAC/ITAR) for the model variants we demoed and outline any blocking items.
- Loop in our compliance and solutions engineering peers for a short follow-up on Private/Dedicated deployment options.

Attached: MedSys_Security_Questionnaire_20270503.pdf (your copy), MAP_MedSys_Redwood_20270503.docx (draft timeline).

Can we aim to have the questionnaire back by Friday 5/7 so we can prioritize compliance review next week?

Thanks,
Marcus
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
From: Anna Kovács <anna.kovacs@medsys.eu>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: MedSys Security <security@medsys.eu>
Date: 2027-05-03T13:40:00+02:00
Subject: Re: MedSys post-demo: security follow-up + region availability & export pre-check

Hi Marcus,

Thanks — we’ll fill out the questionnaire. A few quick items from security: 
1) SOC 2 Type II — please send the most recent report (redacted is fine).
2) Residency — preference is EU-only for production data; we are open to a proof-of-concept in the US if data is synthetic/pseudonymized.
3) Export controls — we need confirmation there are no ITAR/OFAC restrictions on the models or any embedded third-party binaries that could create export issues.
4) HIPAA — confirm whether you support BAA and how PHI is isolated if we use the hosted API vs private deployment.

CC’d our security lead (security@medsys.eu) who will coordinate the questionnaire. We aim to complete it by Friday.

Regards,
Anna
Head of Data Governance | MedSys GmbH
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: dev_patel@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: (none)
Date: 2027-05-03T11:05:00-04:00
Subject: Fwd: MedSys post-demo — SOC2, residency, OFAC/ITAR check (please advise)

Team — forwarding MedSys' security asks (see Anna's note below). Quick help needed: 
- Dev: can you attach the latest redacted SOC 2 Type II and confirm whether any of our model bundles reference third-party binaries with export restrictions?
- Karthik: can you scope a short session (30–45m) to review Dedicated / Private (Frankfurt) options and capacity SLA for a pilot?

Attachments to include in reply: redwood_soc2_type2_redacted.pdf, redwood_eu_region_availability_20270503.pdf.

Also need a crisp line on whether Redwood will execute a BAA and what the gating items are for HIPAA workloads.

Thanks — Marcus
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-03T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: MedSys post-demo — SOC2, residency, OFAC/ITAR check (please advise)

Marcus / Karthik — short answers below and attachments included.

1) SOC 2: attached redwood_soc2_type2_redacted.pdf (covers period 2026-10 to 2027-04). No open exceptions relevant to hosting/data processing controls.

2) EU region availability: We have GA capacity in eu-west-1 (Frankfurt region) for both Hosted Dedicated and Redwood Private (VPC-onboarding). redwood_eu_region_availability_20270503.pdf attached with provisioning SLA and expected lead times (pilot = ~2 weeks for dedicated pool).

3) Export controls: we ran dependency scans. No ITAR-controlled binaries in our runtime or the model weights we distribute. OFAC: we do screening on account onboarding and block transactions for sanctioned entities; models themselves are not on any sanctions lists. If MedSys has any special regulatory flags, we will route through legal for export license checks.

4) HIPAA / BAA: Redwood can execute a BAA for Dedicated and Private deployments. Hosted (multi-tenant) requires additional scoping; will need to lock configuration and possibly use customer-managed keys.

Next steps recommended: I’ll add short answers into the MedSys questionnaire PDF and send back to Marcus for customer handoff.

— Dev
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Kovács <anna.kovacs@medsys.eu>, security@medsys.eu
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-04T09:18:00-04:00
Subject: Re: MedSys post-demo: security follow-up + region availability & export pre-check

Anna — attached are the items Dev mentioned and our filled questionnaire (answers inline). Quick summary for your pack: 
- SOC 2 (redacted) attached.
- EU-only residency is supported via Dedicated or Private — pilot provisioning times and pricing notes in the region doc.
- Export controls: no ITAR binaries identified; OFAC checks are part of onboarding.
- BAA: Redwood will sign a BAA for Dedicated/Private; for Hosted we can discuss customer-managed keys and additional isolation steps.

Attachments: redwood_soc2_type2_redacted.pdf, redwood_eu_region_availability_20270503.pdf, MedSys_Security_Questionnaire_20270503.pdf (answered).

Next steps: 1) Please confirm EU-only requirement (Frankfurt) for production. 2) If you want a Dedicated pilot, propose two slots next week for a 30–45m technical session with Karthik to go over deployment checklist. 3) If you need a formal legal/export statement we can route to Legal and produce a brief memo (1–2 business days).

Proposed times for the technical session: Tue 5/10 09:00–09:45 CEST or Wed 5/11 14:00–14:45 CEST — let me know what works and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Marcus
From: Anna Kovács <anna.kovacs@medsys.eu>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Pablo Torres <p.torres@medsys.eu>, security@medsys.eu
Date: 2027-05-04T15:05:00+02:00
Subject: Re: MedSys post-demo: security follow-up + region availability & export pre-check

Marcus — received, thank you. A couple of clarifications before we schedule the technical session: 
- Can you provide a formal statement (one page) confirming no cross-border transfer of production customer data from EU region without explicit customer consent? We need this for our procurement and DPA.
- For private deployment: confirm whether we can bring our own KMS keys (customer-managed keys) and whether logs/audit trails can be retained in our tenant for 12 months (logs retention policy).
- Please also confirm any residual risk related to OFAC screening on model updates — we need to know whether model updates could introduce new third-party components that might change export posture.

Once we have the one-pager and answers, we’ll confirm the pilot slot — leaning to Tue 5/10 09:00 CEST.

Regards,
Anna
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Kovács <anna.kovacs@medsys.eu>, security@medsys.eu
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-05T16:05:00+02:00
Subject: Re: MedSys post-demo: security follow-up + region availability & export pre-check

Anna — confirmed: we’ll produce the 1-page legal/compliance memo that covers cross-border transfer commitments, KMS options, logs retention, and model-update export monitoring. Legal will aim to provide that by EOD 5/06.

Short answers now: 
- EU-only transfers: yes — production data will remain in EU region unless MedSys provides explicit written consent to allow transfers. We will include this language in the DPA/one-pager.
- Customer-managed KMS: supported for Private and Dedicated (bring-your-own-key via our KMS integration); Hosted can support CMK with some onboarding steps.
- Logs retention: we can retain audit logs for 12 months in your tenant for Private deployments; Hosted options available as an add-on.
- Model-update export posture: we have a change-control process that includes dependency scans and export-control checks for new model artifacts; we will notify customers if an update materially changes export/third-party dependency status.

I’ll send the compliance memo and a calendar invite for Tue 5/10 09:00 CEST (Karthik will run the demo/technical checklist).

Thanks — Marcus
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
